title: Manual for the General Court of New Hampshire 1921, general election returns by town (general election 1920-11-02)

offices.president: Electors of President and Vice-President: one column per ticket (printed as the presidential candidate, or as both candidates, with a party letter); name is the presidential candidate's surname; only the 1920 general election town tables by county (town and ward rows, then a county totals row); label each ward row with its city, for example "Portsmouth Ward 1"; skip councilor, state senator, representative to the General Court, county officer, and question tables
offices.governor: Governor; only the 1920 general election town tables by county (town and ward rows, then a county totals row); label each ward row with its city, for example "Portsmouth Ward 1"; skip councilor, state senator, representative to the General Court, county officer, and question tables
offices.senate: U.S. Senator, not a state senator; only the 1920 general election town tables by county (town and ward rows, then a county totals row); label each ward row with its city, for example "Portsmouth Ward 1"; skip councilor, state senator, representative to the General Court, county officer, and question tables
offices.house: U.S. Representative in Congress, one table per congressional district (First or Second); district is the congressional district number; only the 1920 general election town tables by county (town and ward rows, then a county totals row); label each ward row with its city, for example "Portsmouth Ward 1"; skip councilor, state senator, representative to the General Court, county officer, and question tables

note: Leaves are Internet Archive page indexes (printed pages 257-276: president and governor, then senator and congressmen; the county summary on p. 256 (leaf 271) is the check).
